svg.title: Agent calls paid APIs directly and uses Wallet for x402 authorization
svg.desc: Paid business APIs and the Wallet API are registered in Realmroot. The Agent discovers and calls the business APIs directly. When a service returns a payment requirement, the Agent asks Wallet to authorize the payment, retries the business API with the returned signature, and sends the payment response back to Wallet for confirmation. Gloria AI News, DEX Screener, and AIXBT Agent are shown as example paid services.

g.aria-label: Agent calls Wallet to authorize and confirm x402 payments
